name: Spent caustic treatment (wet air oxidation)
principle: Spent caustic from mercaptan removal, ethylene quench and refinery LPG treating carries sulfides, mercaptides, cresylates and naphthenates at high pH. Wet air oxidation (WAO) oxidises these with air at elevated temperature and pressure so the effluent is biologically treatable; IPIECA notes spent caustic should be neutralised or routed to equalisation to protect the API separators. Linde has supplied WAO since 1970; Evoqua carries the Zimpro legacy.
